dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: That's right — I've chosen something special from Fontaine to give to my lady love.

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: Curious, I'd hope? All the other sailors hurried off to the Court of Fontaine the moment we came ashore. Only I came back here.

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: Sailing is hard work, yeah, but I truly look forward to setting sail once more to see my lady love in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: When it comes to passions, I am nothing if not a serious man. If all goes well, I would even be willing to change lines of work and stay with her.

dialogues.speaker: Lectoure
dialogues.text: But there are quite a few tribes where she lives, and different tribes come with different rules... Will I be able to integrate smoothly?
